rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Including functionality from an untrusted source may allow an attacker to control the functionality and execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Interpreting unsanitized user input as code allows a malicious user arbitrary code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy allows overly broad access.

rules.cwe_name: Password in Configuration File
rules.description: Storing unencrypted passwords in configuration files is unsafe.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: An expression that has no effect and is used in a void context is most likely redundant and may indicate a bug.

rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: An assignment to a local variable that is not used later on, or whose value is always overwritten, has no effect.
